subject: Channel grid synchronization and account claim clarification - NovaSolutions / Velaro
messages:
From: Mira Shah <mira@novasolutions.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Gomez <carlos.gomez@velaro.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick sync: account overlap between NovaSolutions & Velaro for Rivermark PoC

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we ran intake on the Rivermark PoC and noticed a significant overlap in named accounts (northwest vertical) between NovaSolutions and Velaro. Rivermark flagged both of you as active contacts; we want to avoid duplication in outreach or co-sell outreach.

Attachments: I dropped a quick mapping (Nova-PoC-mapping.xlsx) that shows the accounts we see assigned to each partner and the primary contacts. Could you confirm your account list and who at Redwood is the partner owner we should reference when scheduling the kickoff?

High-level asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm which partner (Nova or Velaro) should be primary contact for each account in the attached sheet?
- If we need to split, can we agree a rule-of-thumb (by product line or ARR threshold) so both partners can coordinate handoffs gracefully?

We’re happy to sync 30m tomorrow afternoon. Mira

--
Mira Shah
Head of Alliances, NovaSolutions
[m] +1 415-555-0194
[Attachment: Nova-PoC-mapping.xlsx - spreadsheet, 12KB]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mira Shah <mira@novasolutions.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: account overlap between NovaSolutions & Velaro for Rivermark PoC

Thanks Mira — appreciate the mapping. I pulled the Rivermark record (HubSpot) and confirmed they’ve been engaged by both partners in the last 60 days.

Marissa / Laura — looping you in to adjudicate partner claims and recommend a clean grid we can share with Nova & Velaro. Quick context: Rivermark is committed to a 3-month PoC and wants a single primary partner to coordinate technical onboarding, but both partners should remain in the value chain (co-sell support).

My immediate proposal (so we can move fast):
- For accounts where deal ARR < $75k: partner who introduced the technical contact owns kickoff and primary outreach.
- For accounts where deal ARR >= $75k: schedule a 15m triage with both partners and product lead; if both engaged, default to partner with existing platform integration work (notes in the sheet).

If that sounds ok I’ll share a short grid and grab a 30m tomorrow at 3pm PT with both partners.

Jonas
Director, Alliances Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: account overlap between NovaSolutions & Velaro for Rivermark PoC

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the attached mapping and annotated claims — attached is an annotated PDF (Velaro-CLAIM-annotated.pdf) with our proposed initial split and the business rationale for each row. High level summary: 

- Proposed default split: technical-intro owner (who set up first PoC seat) gets primary kickoff for sub-$75k accounts.
- For larger accounts or accounts with concurrent technical work, we propose a shared engagement (co-owner flag) and a short MOU that defines primary contact for billing/contract and secondary partner for integrations.
- Where both partners have legitimate prior work, we recommend short joint kickoff (15m) + handoff doc created in the shared Drive link.

Next actions I recommend: 
1) Nova & Velaro review the annotated PDF and accept/reject rows by EOD Friday.
2) If rejected, highlight the rows and provide supporting notes; we’ll triage in a short follow-up.
3) Redwood will publish a canonical channel grid (CSV) into the Drive link and flag owner fields for routing in our partner portal.

I’m attaching the PDF with inline comments. If we can get acceptance on 70% of rows this week we can lock routing and coordinate the Rivermark kickoff next week.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Success (Americas)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Velaro-CLAIM-annotated.pdf - annotated PDF, 48KB]

From: Carlos Gomez <carlos.gomez@velaro.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mira Shah <mira@novasolutions.io>
Date: 2026-11-23T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: account overlap between NovaSolutions & Velaro for Rivermark PoC

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear grid — Velaro reviewed the annotated PDF and accepted the majority of the proposed splits. A few notes: 

- We request that account X-142 be listed as co-owned (Velaro primary for integration work; Nova primary for commercial outreach). We added a short rationale in the PDF comments.
- For any account where co-ownership is declared, can Redwood set a single owner in the partner portal but add a secondary partner contact field so we maintain notifications? That will help the Rivermark PM avoid missed communications.

We’ll mark accept/reject in the Drive doc by EOD and are available for a 30m sync on Thursday 11/25 to finalize. After acceptance, please send over the CSV export for our records.

Thanks — Carlos
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Velaro.ai
